title: Vietnamese
description: Everyday Vietnamese: greetings, family, food, numbers, getting around and your day.

units.title: Greetings
units.description: Say hello, introduce yourself and be polite.
tips: Vietnamese has six tones, shown by the accent marks: 'ma', 'má' and 'mà' are different words.

units.title: People and family
units.description: Talk about the people around you.
tips: Words for 'he' and 'she' depend on age: 'anh ấy' (he, a young man), 'cô ấy' (she, a young woman).

units.title: Food and drink
tips: 'Cơm' is cooked rice and also means a meal; 'gạo' is uncooked rice.

units.title: Numbers
units.description: Count from one to ten, ask prices and tell the time.
tips: Counting words come before nouns: 'bốn quả táo' (four apples), 'hai đứa con' (two children).

units.title: Travel and directions
units.description: Find your way around a new city.
tips: 'Ở đâu' (where) goes at the end: 'Khách sạn ở đâu?' = Hotel is where?

units.title: Daily routine
units.description: Home, work, school and the time of day.
tips: Verbs never change: 'tôi đi', 'bạn đi', 'họ đi' (I go, you go, they go).

units.title: Shopping
units.description: Ask for things, prices and how to pay.
tips: 'Bao nhiêu?' asks how much; 'quá' after a word means too: 'đắt quá' = too expensive.
